Hamming.toHamming_symm_eq.thmStatement: ∀ {ι : Type u_2} {β : ι → Type u_3}, Hamming.toHamming.symm = Hamming.ofHamming

pass.proof:
fun {ι} {β} => by
  simp only [Equiv.refl.eq_1, Equiv.symm.eq_1, Hamming.ofHamming.eq_1, Equiv.mk.injEq, Hamming.toHamming.eq_1] <;>
    simpa only [Equiv.mk.injEq] using
        Equiv.refl._proof_1 (((a : ι) → β a) ≃ ((a : ι) → β a))
          { toFun := fun a => a, invFun := fun a => a, left_inv := fun x => Eq.refl x, right_inv := fun x => Eq.refl x }

  (j : J) (X : C (g j)), (CategoryTheory.Sigma.map C g).obj ⟨j, X⟩ = ⟨g j, X⟩

pass.proof:
fun {I} C [(i : I) → CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} (C i)] {J} g j X => by
  simp only [Sigma.mk.injEq, CategoryTheory.Sigma.desc.eq_1, CategoryTheory.Sigma.incl.eq_1,

  {j : J} {X Y : C (g j)} (f : X ⟶ Y),

pass.proof:
fun I C [inst : (i : I) → CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} (C i)] x =>
  _inhabitedExprDummy I C (fun i => (inst i).1.1.1) (fun i => (inst i).1.2) (fun i => (inst i).1.3) ⋯ ⋯ ⋯ x.1 x.2

CategoryTheory.Sigma.incl_map.thmStatement:

CategoryTheory.Sigma.SigmaHom.mk.injEq.thmStatement:
∀ {I : Type w₁} {C : I → Type u₁} [inst : (i : I) → CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} (C i)] {i : I} {X Y : C i}
  (a a_1 : X ⟶ Y), (CategoryTheory.Sigma.SigmaHom.mk a = CategoryTheory.Sigma.SigmaHom.mk a_1) = (a = a_1)

CategoryTheory.Sigma.SigmaHom.mk.inj.thmStatement:
∀ {I : Type w₁} {C : I → Type u₁} {inst : (i : I) → CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} (C i)} {i : I} {X Y : C i}
  {a a_1 : X ⟶ Y}, CategoryTheory.Sigma.SigmaHom.mk a = CategoryTheory.Sigma.SigmaHom.mk a_1 → a = a_1

CategoryTheory.Sigma.SigmaHom.id_comp.thmStatement:
∀ {I : Type w₁} {C : I → Type u₁} [inst : (i : I) → CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} (C i)] {X Y : (i : I) × C i}
  (f : X ⟶ Y), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id X) f = f

CategoryTheory.Sigma.SigmaHom.comp_id.thmStatement:
∀ {I : Type w₁} {C : I → Type u₁} [inst : (i : I) → CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} (C i)] {X Y : (i : I) × C i}
  (f : X ⟶ Y), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp f (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id Y) = f

CategoryTheory.Sigma.SigmaHom.comp_def.thmStatement:
∀ {I : Type w₁} {C : I → Type u₁} [inst : (i : I) → CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} (C i)] (i : I) (X Y Z : C i)
  (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z),
  (CategoryTheory.Sigma.SigmaHom.mk f).comp (CategoryTheory.Sigma.SigmaHom.mk g) =
    CategoryTheory.Sigma.SigmaHom.mk (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp f g)

CategoryTheory.Sigma.SigmaHom.assoc.thmStatement:
∀ {I : Type w₁} {C : I → Type u₁} [inst : (i : I) → CategoryTheory.Category.{v₁, u₁} (C i)] {X Y Z W : (i : I) × C i}
  (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) (h : Z ⟶ W),
  CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp f g) h =
    CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp f (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp g h)
